A little clarity before you start

Good questions.

What information should I send about my project?

Start with your city, the type of project, and a few photos. Approximate dimensions, access details, and your preferred timing can help make the conversation more useful.

Can I discuss more than one improvement?

Yes. Choose “Multiple projects” in the inquiry form and describe your ideas for retaining walls, a patio, driveway, landscaping, or wood fencing.

How do I get a price and find out about availability?

Call or text (916) 728-8990 with your project details. Scope, materials, access, and site conditions affect pricing. Confirm the estimate and schedule directly with the business.

Where is the business based?

Retaining Walls and Landscaping is based in Roseville, California. Send your project location to confirm service availability.
